description.value: At 6th level, a summoner can attempt to counter a summoning spell cast by another creature. He must identify the spell being cast as normal for counterspelling. If he does so, he can attempt to counter the spell as a swift or immediate action. To counter the spell, the summoner must attempt a dispel check as if using dispel. If the spell being countered is a summon monster or summon nature's ally spell, the summoner gains a +5 bonus on the dispel check. The summoner can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + his Charisma modifier.
